name: self-coder
description: Allows Prometheus to write code and create new capabilities for itself.

create_draft_skill.description: Write code for a new skill. Saves it to a staging area for review.

code_js.description: The JavaScript code for the skill (ESM format)

tool_spec.description: The JSON object describing the tool for skill.json

consult_senior_dev.description: Ask the Senior Developer (Gemini Flash) to write complex code or solve hard problems.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the code or solution needed

install_skill.description: Install a drafted skill to the active skills directory.

name.description: Name of the skill to install

switch_model.description: Swap the agent's brain between local (Qwen) and cloud (Gemini) models.

read_file.description: Read the content of a file (limit 500 lines). If the exact path is unknown, use 'search_files' first.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read (relative to project root)

apply_patch.description: Apply a precise search-and-replace patch to a file. safe than sed/echo.

file_path.description: Path to the file to modify

target_content.description: Exact string to find and replace (must match exactly)

replacement_content.description: New string to replace the target with

search_files.description: Search for files by pattern or name across ~/Documents. Use this to find files before reading them.

search_root.description: Optional: Specific directory to search within (defaults to ~/Documents)

write_file.description: Write content to a file. Overwrites if exists. Creates directory if needed.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: The full text content to write

checkpoint.description: Creates a Git-based save point (tag) for a file before making risky changes.

file_path.description: Path to the file to checkpoint

label.description: Description of why this checkpoint is being made

rollback_patch.description: Restores a file to its last healthy state using Git. Useful after a patch breaks syntax.

file_path.description: Path to the file to roll back

tag.description: Optional: Specific Git tag to restore from

verify_syntax.description: Validates that a JavaScript file is syntactically correct and won't crash on import.

file_path.description: Path to the .js file to verify

run_quick_test.description: Executes a temporary JS test script to verify functional correctness of a fix.

test_code.description: The full JavaScript code for the test script

adjust_intent_priority.description: Adjust the prioritization boost for a specific tool. Use this when the user corrects your tool selection or gives explicit priority instructions.

skill_id.description: The ID of the skill to boost (e.g., 'gmail', 'knowledge-base')

boost.description: The amount to increase/decrease priority. Default is 5. Use negative numbers to decrease.
